title: Realm 1: Painting the Web
description: Build your first webpage using tags, images, links, colors, and layout.

lessons.title: 1. Headings & Paragraphs
lessons.concept:
### Welcome to HTML! 🎨 HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It gives every webpage its skeleton! Elements are wrapped in opening and closing tags: - `

Big Title

` for the main heading - `

This is a paragraph of text.

` for text - `` for clickable buttons!

lessons.title: 2. Buttons & Styling with CSS
lessons.concept:
### Adding Style with CSS
You can add colors, rounded corners, and glowing buttons using CSS:

```html
<button style="background-color: #38bdf8; color: #000; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: bold;">
  Launch Rocket 🚀
</button>
```
lessons.task: Create a `<button>` with style `background-color: gold; color: black;` and button text `Claim Reward ✨`.
lessons.solution:
<button style="background-color: gold; color: black; font-weight: bold; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px;">
  Claim Reward ✨
</button>
hints: Set background-color: gold; and text 'Claim Reward ✨'
